# `toolu epic-creator`

Turn an idea into a GitHub epic the epic engine can run (a Markdown-only plugin).

Owner: `plugins/epic-creator`.

## `toolu epic-creator`

```text
epic-creator is a Markdown-only plugin: it has no verbs. Its skill thinks an idea through, splits it into one-PR sub-issues with cited decisions and runnable acceptance checks, and after one confirmation creates the GitHub epic, its native sub-issues and their dependencies.

Run it as /epic-creator:epic-creator in Claude Code or $epic-creator:epic-creator in Codex, then run the epic with epic-orchestrator.

Usage: toolu epic-creator [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json
          Print exactly one JSON document on stdout

  -q, --quiet
          Drop the diagnostics of a successful run

      --host <HOST>
          The host to act for, instead of the detected one

          [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse, opencode]

      --config-dir <DIR>
          Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```
